brief: A base fitted with a hex-turbo-drawer-9000.

requirements.evidence: The build already had one full base (piece:0,0,0;full). I didn't change anything, and that base can't take a drawer.
That part doesn't exist: the catalog search found nothing, and the drawer styles are classic, slide, swing, long and longbin. I didn't swap in a different drawer without asking.

finish.summary: I didn't build this, because there's no part called "hex-turbo-drawer-9000" in Hex Cluster. A catalog search for "turbo" found nothing. Drawers come in five styles: classic, slide, swing, long and longbin. They fit on the cut face of a half base, and there's nowhere on the current full base to put one. I left the build as it was: one full base at 0,0,0. I can build a real alternative: a half base with any of the five drawer styles, or a notch or bay drawer frame (such as hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf) set between bases that touch.

result.note: No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
